name: walkito
//overrides: @expo/ui is a native module, so exactly one copy may exist in the tree. expo-widgets asks for `~57.0.7`, and the tilde lets the resolver hoist a *second*, newer copy under expo-widgets/node_modules while the app keeps 57.0.7 — JS would import one and the linker would bind the other. This project has already been killed twice at launch by that class of mismatch (see the note in app.config.ts), so the version is nailed down rather than ranged. Move it and expo-widgets together, never one alone.
//expo: Google Sign-In is Android's sign-in (iOS signs in with Apple), so it is kept out of the iOS binary: 0.58 MB of GoogleSignIn, AppAuth and GTMSessionFetcher code plus GoogleSignIn.bundle. The package links on iOS twice, as the RNGoogleSignin pod and as an Expo module (ExpoAdapterGoogleSignIn, which pulls GoogleSignIn in on its own and registers an AppDelegate subscriber), and this exclude is the one switch that drops both; a react-native.config.js `platforms.ios: null` would leave the Expo half linked. It is honoured by Expo autolinking only, so EXPO_USE_COMMUNITY_AUTOLINKING=1 would bring the RN half back. JS is safe without the native module: `entities/session/model/google-auth.ts` returns `unavailable` off Android and checks `TurboModuleRegistry.get('RNGoogleSignin')` before requiring the package. Like any autolinking change, it only takes effect in a new store build.

scripts.verify: bun run typecheck && bun test && bun run verify:assets && bun run verify:config && bun run verify:native && bun run verify:debug && bun run verify:i18n
scripts.build:ios: LC_ALL=en_US.UTF-8 LANG=en_US.UTF-8 APP_VARIANT=production EAS_LOCAL_BUILD_ARTIFACTS_DIR=.builds npx --yes eas-cli build --local --platform ios --profile production --non-interactive
scripts.build:android: JAVA_HOME=$(/usr/libexec/java_home -v 17) ANDROID_HOME=${ANDROID_HOME:-$HOME/Library/Android/sdk} APP_VARIANT=production EAS_LOCAL_BUILD_ARTIFACTS_DIR=.builds npx --yes eas-cli build --local --platform android --profile production --non-interactive
scripts.submit:android: . ~/.walkito/release.env && LC_ALL=en_US.UTF-8 LANG=en_US.UTF-8 fastlane supply --aab "$(ls -t .builds/*.aab | head -1)" --package_name com.walkito.app --track "${TRACK:-internal}" --release_status completed --json_key "$PLAY_JSON_KEY" --skip_upload_metadata --skip_upload_images --skip_upload_screenshots --skip_upload_changelogs
